```yaml
name: Publish
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*.*.*"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Test Summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: "coverage/lcov.info"
          output: "test-results.md"
          show: "all"

      - name: Build package
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish to npm
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update Docker Hub Description
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        uses: peter-evans/dockerhub-description@v4
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD }}
          repository: gotalab/cc-sdd
          readme-filepath: ./README.md
          short-description: "AI-native containerized application for SDD processing"

      - name: Update README with AI-DLC emphasis
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          README_CONTENT=$(cat README.md)
          NEW_README="$README_CONTENT

## AI-Native Development Lifecycle

This project follows an AI-native approach with minimal human approval gates, enabling rapid iteration and deployment through automated workflows."
          echo "$NEW_README" > README.md

      - name: Commit README changes
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "docs: update README with AI-DLC emphasis"
          author_name: "GitHub Actions"
          author_email: "actions@github.com"
```
